key_findings: CIH, lingual nerve injury and tongue inflammation each produced prolonged tongue mechanical allodynia.
Only CIH increased Piezo2 neurons, satellite glial GFAP and persistent cFos, indicating central sensitization; TRPV4 rose in LNI and TI but not CIH.
